scope.objective: Profile a flat late-time interacting-vacuum background on DES-Dovekie alone in (Omega_m0, g=Gamma/H0), analytically profiling one shared additive magnitude intercept.

interacting_vacuum_paper.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?

data_contract.format: SNANA whitespace VARNAMES/SN records despite .csv suffix

redshift_semantics.zHD: Hubble-diagram/CMB-frame redshift with peculiar-velocity correction; used in the expansion integral
redshift_semantics.zHEL: heliocentric redshift; used in the luminosity-distance prefactor

data_contract.muerr_handling: MUERR and MUERR_SYS are diagnostics and are not added separately to the released STAT+SYS covariance

background_model.scope: Flat, late-time matter plus interacting vacuum; radiation and neutrinos omitted, with no perturbation or early-universe calculation.
background_model.gamma_zero_limit: At g=0, x=1-Omega_m0 and m=Omega_m0*(1+z)^3, exactly flat LCDM.

sn_distance_and_identifiability.h0_gauge_role: Common arbitrary distance scale consistent with released MU convention; its change is an additive magnitude absorbed by the profiled intercept.
sn_distance_and_identifiability.identifiability: Dovekie alone cannot separate H0 from the common SN absolute-magnitude/calibration intercept. The dimensionless shape g may affect relative distances; dimensional Gamma cannot be inferred without H0 calibration.

covariance_and_profile_likelihood.stored_quantity: Packed upper triangle of full STAT+SYS precision P=C^-1
covariance_and_profile_likelihood.row_mapping: Unpack and reflect the precision in exact release Hubble-diagram order; do not sort or join rows.
covariance_and_profile_likelihood.precision_positive_definite: Verified in the source data contract; require successful Cholesky factorization in the fit adapter.
covariance_and_profile_likelihood.intercept_domain: Unbounded real additive magnitude offset, shared by all 1820 rows

definitions.profile_chi2: r^T P r = delta^T P delta - (1^T P delta)^2/q

covariance_and_profile_likelihood.normalization: C is fixed across shape parameters. If the absolute normalized profile is recorded, compute log|C|=-log|P| from a Cholesky factorization. The official flat-prior marginalization adds log(q/(2*pi)); that term is not included in the requested profile likelihood and is shape-constant for this fixed covariance.
excluded_terms: No separate MUERR or MUERR_SYS diagonal variance
No training/holdout split or conditional predictive covariance
No redshift-dependent or per-fold magnitude intercept

physical_feasibility.interval_choice: Check the entire Dovekie observed interval from today to max(zHD); this is the SN-only likelihood domain. The integrator's maximum supported requested redshift remains 2.33.

baryon_split.candidate_guard: Require a nonempty open positive-split interval and check an interior witness f_b=f_b_max/2.

physical_feasibility.grid_check: Sample the full interval densely (current code uses at least 257 points and spacing <=0.002 in u); refine at accepted profile points to check for missed narrow invalid regions.
physical_feasibility.uncalibrated_fb_limitation: No CMB or BBN baryon calibration is in scope. A positive witness establishes only that some physical split exists; f_b is neither measured nor fitted. The previously used f_b=0.16 is illustrative only and is not imposed.

Omega_m0.role: Initial finite numerical search domain, inherited from scripts/background_bao.py; not a paper prior.

g.role: Initial finite numerical search domain matching the current BAO screen and the paper Table I IVS uniform prior.

search_domain.paper_Omega_m0_prior: No direct Omega_m0 prior in Table I; the paper lists omega_b=Omega_b*h^2 in [0.005, 0.1] and omega_c=Omega_c*h^2 in [0.001, 0.99] separately.
search_domain.magnitude_intercept: Profiled analytically over the real line; no bounds.
search_domain.boundary_rule: Record face hits. If the selected maximum or relevant surface touches a shape-box face, extend/recheck the domain before treating the profile as closed.

bao_ivs_shape.status: Previously selected BAO-only point; coordinates are a fixed reference, not refit here.

bao_lcdm_shape.status: Previously selected nested BAO-only LCDM point; optional fixed reference.

bao_point_comparison.allowed_comparison: Overlay fixed BAO coordinates on the SN-only profile and report the SN-only profile displacement chi2_SN_prof(BAO point)-min chi2_SN_prof as descriptive geometry.
prohibited_interpretations: No BAO+SN likelihood product or summed score
No joint evidence or posterior preference
No exact independence claim; audited products supply no BAO-SN cross-covariance
No p-value, sigma, or Wilks-calibrated interval from profile differences or contour thresholds

required_fit_diagnostics: Record data, source-code, paper, contract, and BAO-reference identities/hashes; record row count/order hash and both redshift ranges.
Require Cholesky factorization of full P and record the profile normal-equation residual and fixed-covariance normalization convention.
At the selected point and reported profile points, record Omega_m0, g, Mhat, profiled chi2, physicality minima, f_b_max, witness fraction, and search-bound hits.
Retain all optimizer statuses and endpoint objective rechecks; use multiple starts and a coarse full-box surface/refinement check, without claiming globality from these checks.
Check the g=0 LCDM distance limit and independently compute distances at the selected point and fixed BAO point with a declared tolerance.
Count solver failures and physical-domain rejections; refine the feasibility guard at accepted points.
Report the BAO-point SN-profile displacement as descriptive only.

synthetic_algebra_check.scope: One 3-vector synthetic SPD covariance check of analytic intercept profiling only

review_gate.reason: The independent frozen-shape review concerns the conditional redshift-fold calculation; this new profile uses the full unpartitioned Dovekie likelihood.

previous_frozen_shape_empirical_reproduc.scope_note: This closes the earlier frozen-shape review; it does not validate the future profile implementation.

review_gate.new_profile_interpretation_gate: The new profile's own full-covariance, independent-distance, and physical-feasibility diagnostics must pass before its result is interpreted.

unresolved_conditions: The search box is fixed initially; any relevant boundary contact requires domain extension/recheck before interpreting a closed profile.
The continuous physicality condition is represented numerically by a dense grid; accepted points require a refined check.
A calibrated baryon fraction is unavailable, so only existential baryon/CDM feasibility can be checked.
